name: Dues & Contributions
description: Track organization dues collection — billing periods, per-member payment status, allocation rules that post immediately to reserve funds when dues are recorded, and period close reconciliation.

assessments.sql: SELECT * FROM app_dues_contributions__assessments ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 500

settings.sql: SELECT value FROM app_dues_contributions__settings WHERE key = 'board_group_id'

suggested_automations.title: Put each billing period's due date on the calendar
suggested_automations.description: When a billing period is created — or its due date moves — put an all-day event on the calendar for the day dues are due. The deadline is the one thing every member needs in front of them, and the calendar is where the organization already looks. Editing the date moves the entry that is already there instead of adding a second one beside it. Only the period's label and its due date go out: no member's balance, amount owed, or payment status is ever part of the entry.

suggested_automations.title: Take a closed period's due date back off the calendar
suggested_automations.description: The other half of the rule above, and it only does anything if you have that one. When a billing period is closed, deleted, or has its due date cleared, the entry it put on the calendar stops showing — instead of standing as a deadline the organization has already settled. Add both, or the due date outlives the period.

source.query: SELECT id AS id, label AS title, due_date AS when_at FROM app_dues_contributions__periods WHERE status = 'open' AND due_date = :today ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 20
SELECT id AS id, label AS title, due_date AS when_at FROM app_dues_contributions__assessments WHERE due_date = :today ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 20
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM app_dues_contributions__periods WHERE status = 'open' AND due_date IS NOT NULL AND due_date <> '' AND due_date <= :today LIMIT 1
